fusions.name: Wild Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a knife wrapped in raw arcana that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Spilled Arcana
fusions.desc: Spills raw arcana off the blade, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Floating Dagger
fusions.desc: Sets a dagger floating beside you for 10 seconds. Every second it strikes an enemy within 6 tiles for 4 damage.

fusions.name: Stray Edges
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, a crackling bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 lightning damage. Once every 5 seconds.
